slides.heading: Get checked if you notice

caption:
Mr Turtle nearly bought a posture brace at 11pm.

Most braces work as a reminder: you feel the straps tug when you slump. That can be handy for short stints while you build new habits, but they don't strengthen anything while you wear them, and wearing one all day can swap one set position for another.

What tends to help more is changing position often, plus a couple of short upper back strength sessions a week. Band pull-aparts and towel extensions are a good start. Chiropractic care can be one helpful tool alongside that.

Arm pain, pins and needles, weakness or pain that wakes you at night is worth getting checked. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
